about: Places in the boxwork where Curiosity parked, used as extra stops for daily missions. Built by scripts/prepare_rover_stops.py: on usable rover-driven ground (within 3 m), within 2000 m of the start, at least 60 m apart, newest first. Tasks are ours.

stops.name: Sol 5073 stop
stops.found: Curiosity ended a drive here on sol 5073 (NASA waypoint data).
tasksOurs: Photograph the ground where the rover parked.
Compare the wheel tracks with the ground beside them.
Note the rock or sand under the tracks.
